notes.title: Update 2016050811
notes.notes:
First update after seeing some feedback from reviewers & streamers:
[list]
[*] More optimizations of texture & object (pre)loading - massively reducing in-game jitter (FPS Spikes)
[*] Video options now available within the Options area
[*] Game targetted FPS can now be set within options (if you want to reduce CPU usage, or if you'd prefer more stable FPS for stream recording)
[*] New power-up "Magic Mushroom"
[/list]
